name: Strongly Faithful Peano Subgraphs and Retracts
statement: Every strongly faithful subgraph of a Peano partial cube is Peano, and every retract of a Peano partial cube is strongly faithful. The converse to the latter implication fails: the gated amalgam of $C_4$ and $K_2$ along one vertex is strongly faithful in $Q_3=C_4\square K_2$ but is not a retract.
